cards.name: Grookey
cards.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Scorbunny
cards.description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker
cards.description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

cards.name: Wooloo
cards.description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta
cards.description: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Flapple
cards.description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Garbodor
cards.description: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

cards.name: Mantine
cards.description: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Rayquaza
cards.description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Morpeko

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

cards.name: Zamazenta
cards.description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

cards.name: Arctozolt
cards.description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

cards.name: Hatenna
cards.description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

cards.name: Gengar

cards.description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

cards.description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Sylveon
